title: fragaria viridis subvar. magnusiana
intro: Fragaria viridis subvar. magnusiana, commonly known as wild strawberry or green strawberry, is a type of strawberry plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can help protect against chronic diseases like cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria viridis subvar. magnusiana include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
